title: 礦區 C 鐵礦
titleEn: Mining Area C iron ore hub
summary: 以多採區共用處理與鐵路介面的鐵礦樞紐為例，練習瓶頸與存量分析。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A multi-pit iron-ore hub with shared processing and rail interfaces provides a case for bottleneck and inventory analysis. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊；多座處理設施的輸送量界面；共同裝車前的礦種品質整合
v31FocusEn: Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub; Flow interfaces between multiple handling facilities; Ore-type quality integration before shared train loading

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」與「多座處理設施的輸送量界面」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub" and "Flow interfaces between multiple handling facilities": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub" is correct?
options: 車隊產能取決於載重、往返循環時間與可用率，單看車輛數會高估輸送能力。
卡車加倍就一定能讓礦石產能加倍。
輸送帶速度正常就表示輸送噸數正常。
optionsEn: Fleet capacity depends on payload, round-trip time and availability; counting trucks alone overstates transport.
Doubling trucks necessarily doubles ore throughput.
Normal belt speed guarantees normal transported tonnage.
quiz.explanation: 車隊產能取決於載重、往返循環時間與可用率，單看車輛數會高估輸送能力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fleet capacity depends on payload, round-trip time and availability; counting trucks alone overstates transport. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Mining Area C iron ore hub”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「礦區 C 鐵礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」。車隊產能取決於載重、往返循環時間與可用率，單看車輛數會高估輸送能力。裝載、行駛、卸載與等待要分開計時；本式把完整循環視為平均值，排隊及道路交會仍需離散事件模型補充。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Mining Area C iron ore hub as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses queues when several pits supply one crushing hub. This formula uses a mean full cycle, while queues and road interactions require a supplementary discrete-event model. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」的模型 Q = N·L·60·a / t，運搬循環與有效產能的合成教學算例；輸入單位：N: trucks; L: t/truck; a: fraction; t: min/cycle。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = N·L·60·a / t for "Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for haul-cycle capacity; input units: N: trucks; L: t/truck; a: fraction; t: min/cycle. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: Q = N·L·60·a / t；代入 N = 8 trucks、L = 180 t/truck、a = 0.82 fraction、t = 42 min/cycle，得 1,687 t/h（運搬循環與有效產能的合成教學算例；輸入單位：N: trucks; L: t/truck; a: fraction; t: min/cycle。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = N·L·60·a / t; with N = 8 trucks, L = 180 t/truck, a = 0.82 fraction, t = 42 min/cycle the result is 1,687 t/h (synthetic teaching example for haul-cycle capacity; input units: N: trucks; L: t/truck; a: fraction; t: min/cycle. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = N·L·60·a / t；代入 N = 8 trucks、L = 180 t/truck、a = 0.82 fraction、t = 42 min/cycle，得 1,687 t/h（運搬循環與有效產能的合成教學算例；輸入單位：N: trucks; L: t/truck; a: fraction; t: min/cycle。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 t 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = N·L·60·a / t; with N = 8 trucks, L = 180 t/truck, a = 0.82 fraction, t = 42 min/cycle the result is 1,687 t/h (synthetic teaching example for haul-cycle capacity; input units: N: trucks; L: t/truck; a: fraction; t: min/cycle. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise t by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：t 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,534 t/h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising t by 10% changes the result to 1,534 t/h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1,687 t/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 t 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1,687 t/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in t with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Queues when several pits supply one crushing hub"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」，以時間戳重建合成循環，列出中位數與九成分位數；確認停機時間只扣除一次，避免同時放入循環與可用率。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For queues when several pits supply one crushing hub, reconstruct synthetic cycles from timestamps and report median and ninetieth percentile.
quiz.explanation: 針對「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」，以時間戳重建合成循環，列出中位數與九成分位數；確認停機時間只扣除一次，避免同時放入循環與可用率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For queues when several pits supply one crushing hub, reconstruct synthetic cycles from timestamps and report median and ninetieth percentile; subtract downtime only once rather than including it in both cycle time and availability. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「多礦坑供應同一破碎樞紐的排隊」情境，加車後產量不升可能是卸料口或裝載設備成為瓶頸；觀察等待時間的位置，不能以平均速度判定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instructionEn: Using Mining Area C iron ore hub as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses flow interfaces between multiple handling facilities. steps.observation: 連結機制：這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「輸送帶速度正常就表示輸送噸數正常。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal belt speed guarantees normal transported tonnage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「多座處理設施的輸送量界面」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of flow interfaces between multiple handling facilities, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
